name: Saiminjutsu 4
source:
Ever since the loss of his parents at a young age, the protagonist has been living with his two older sisters. He had a good relationship with his childhood friends and his classmates, and lived a fairly happy life, though always fearful of losing that happiness. But then, abusing the power of "hypnosis" which he had been taught, the protagonist's life spun out of control...
(translated from the official site)
translation:
主人公幼年失去父母后，一直和两位姐姐生活。他与青梅竹马和同学关系很好，过着相当幸福的生活，却始终害怕失去这份幸福。

然而，他滥用别人教给自己的“催眠”力量，人生开始失控……
